lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the pectoral fin (lower right) and more sparsely distributed across the lateral flank area posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs on the lateral flank, forming a preliminary grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical intensity gradient, characterized by high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges, across the upper lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Irregular labyrinthine or vermiculated light-intensity patterns are present on the dorsal head and shoulder regions, contrasting with the discrete circular spot morphology.
